records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Quick hand getting your first project up
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Sorry we missed each other for the kickoff last week — happy to find a time that works better for you.

If it's useful, I can walk you through creating your first project in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so it's the quickest way to see how things fit together. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project too, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Just reply with a time and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Priya
